findings.source_quote: ...some six feet in diameter and over 100 feet tall...
findings.suggested_fix: Translate and present measurements consistently in the target language. Replace the mixed English/metric phrasing with Swedish and metric equivalents, e.g. "cirka 1,8 m i diameter och över 30 m höga" (or keep both units entirely in Swedish: "cirka sex fot i diameter och över 30 meter höga"), and remove the stray English unit words ("feet"). Preserve the numeric meaning and approximate conversion.
findings.translation_quote: ...vissa sex feet (cirka 1,8 m) i diameter och över 100 feet (över 30 m) höga...
